jurisdictionSectionInfo: Please answer all questions in this form with reference to the jurisdiction identified below.
jurisdiction: 2. Jurisdiction covered by the ABS legal framework
jurisdictionRecordUniquenessInfo: Only one record is allowed per jurisdiction. For Sub-national, Community or Other jurisdictions, giving a different jurisdiction name creates a separate, allowed record.
jurisdictionSubNationalInfo: Sub-national jurisdictions include dependencies, territories, autonomous entities, regions, provinces, and states below the national or federal level of government.
jurisdictionScopeDescription: 3. Please describe the scope of the ABS framework
jurisdictionScopeDescriptionInfo: Please provide any clarification on the territorial, legal or administrative scope. Where relevant, explain how this framework relates to other jurisdictions or ABS legal frameworks within the country.
establishedMeasure: 4. To what extent have legislative, administrative or policy measures on ABS been established for this jurisdiction?
establishedMeasureInfo: This includes measures on access, benefit-sharing and compliance.

agrNonCommercialPermitRequiredInfo: For example, please describe the types of non-commercial ABS permits available in your jurisdiction, the activities that require a non-commercial ABS permit, and any other relevant information.

article8ResearchSupport: 16. Do the ABS measures for this jurisdiction promote and encourage research that contributes to the conservation and sustainable use of biodiversity?
article8SimplifiedAccessMeasures: If either 'yes' is selected, please indicate whether this includes simplified access measures for non-commercial research.
article8Emergencies: 17. Do the ABS measures for this jurisdiction take account of present or imminent emergencies that threaten or damage human, animal or plant health?
article8EmergenciesInfo: Please explain how the measures address the need for expeditious access to genetic resources and expeditious fair and equitable benefit-sharing, including access to affordable treatments by those in need.
article8FoodSecurity: 18. Do the ABS measures for this jurisdiction take into account the importance of genetic resources for food and agriculture and their special role in food security?
article8FoodSecurityInfo: Please explain how the ABS measures address this consideration. Where applicable, identify any relevant provisions, procedures, exemptions or other arrangements and indicate the genetic resources or activities to which they apply.
complianceTitle: Measures on compliance with domestic legislation or regulatory requirements on ABS and monitoring the utilization of genetic resources
article15Implemented: 19. Are appropriate, effective and proportionate measures in place to ensure that genetic resources utilised in this jurisdiction were accessed in accordance with the prior informed consent and mutually agreed terms required by the domestic ABS legislation or regulatory requirements of the other Party?
article16Implemented: 20. Has your country taken appropriate, effective and proportionate measures to provide that traditional knowledge associated with genetic resources utilized within its jurisdiction has been accessed with the prior informed consent or approval and involvement of indigenous peoples and local communities and that mutually agreed terms have been established in accordance with the domestic requirements of the Party where such indigenous peoples and local communities are located?
article17Implemented: 21. Are users of genetic resources required to provide the information specified in Article 17, paragraph 1(a)(i), to one or more designated checkpoints in this jurisdiction?
